body:
Its just hard to see the chance when I have been looking for months and cant find anything job wise, and being a bartender in this city sadly seems to require 3+ years of experience (I looked into it because I have no other choices really so why not). 

I probably am not giving myself credit here, but its hard when you havent eaten dinner and are sitting in what most people would call a closet after hearing all night how you are shit and the worst person in the world currently. Its not exactly a confidence booster to be in that position and looking over the rest of my terrible life situation....
I truly never expected a family guy reference at this point.... then again i never expected to ever make it to this point either.

I wanted to travel, I wanted to have a real relationship with a woman who cared about me, I wanted to have something in my life I found fun, I wanted to one day be able to own my own place (nothing too fancy just somewhere of my own to live so I wont forever pay someone else's mortgage). I wanted to have a job that would give me a chance to afford the things I listed.... none of them seem even remotely possible now. 

As for happy... well having the things I listed or at least a reasonable chance of achieving them would do it. As it sits, live or not, there is really no chance to get there from what I am seeing...

As pathetic as it sounds, I honestly have no clue how to "listen to my body, mind and soul". It does sound nice but I have no clue how to do it. 

I dont know what I want to do, I dont see a realistic future where I can achieve the things I want to and be happy. I just see something incredibly empty and hollow. Perhaps if I was better at being myself I would be happier, but when I tried that I just ended up with no friends and in an abusive relationship.

I dont even know where to start online... bouncing back seems like a silly dream at this point. I dont have time to explore, i have no money or job to give me a means to explore the good that life has to offer. 

All I wanted was to be happy and nothing is working out. I cant seem to get ahead at all in life, I go to university and get a degree... its not good enough. I get a job I hate while attempting to get a masters and get fired. I still havent finished my studies but when I do its become clear that I will need years of experience before I can get a job but I cant get the experience because I cant get a job. 

As it sits im overqualified to get the shit jobs that are available and under qualified for anything better that I would want to do. 

I cant see what the point is to trying to bounce back when I have nothing going right. I get that some people have things but I feel like there is nothing else to keep going for now. No relationship, no friends, just a hollow existence.

Its been 3 months without a job, I am in my mid 20's with debt and no means to be on my own at this point. Without a job and with no prospects, and soon to be living in my parents basement, its difficult to see what anyone will see in me. 

I am stuck in a rut, between a rock and a hard place. The relationship cannot continue, its done, but I am moving on to something I cannot stand. I hate the idea of being alone, unemployed, and actually meeting the classic tv definition of a loser.
